_doc: Path patterns + body hashes from prior ascendc-op-gen versions. /aog-preflight uses this to identify obsolete hook entries in user-global ~/.claude/settings.json AND project-local .claude/settings.json that lack the _owner tag (i.e., installed before tagging was added). Each entry triggers an interactive y/N prompt before removal (defensive — user-global may have customizations).

_history.note: Hooks before V3.7 lived at merged_skills/scripts/workflow_critic.py path and lacked _owner tags. Detection via path_patterns above.
